description: This file implements the SQL store for managing Mattermost sidebar categories and channels, including creation, updating, deletion, and migration of sidebar categories and channels, with specific handling for favorites, custom categories, and orphaned channels.

classes.name: userMembership
classes.description: Represents a user's membership in a channel and its associated category.

classes.name: sidebarCategoryForJoin
classes.description: Represents a sidebar category with an optional channel ID for join operations.

classes.name: OrphanedSidebarChannel
classes.description: Represents a channel that is not explicitly in any sidebar category, including its ID and type.

methods.name: CreateInitialSidebarCategories
methods.description: Creates default sidebar categories for a user and team, migrating favorites and setting up default categories.

methods.name: migrateMembershipToSidebar
methods.description: Migrates user memberships into sidebar channels based on a SQL query.

methods.name: migrateFavoritesToSidebarT
methods.description: Migrates user favorite preferences into sidebar channels for a specific user and team.

methods.name: MigrateFavoritesToSidebarChannels
methods.description: Bulk migration of user favorite preferences into sidebar channels for all users after a certain user ID.

methods.name: CreateSidebarCategory
methods.description: Creates a new custom sidebar category with optional channels, maintaining order and handling channel migration.

methods.name: completePopulatingCategoryT
methods.description: Ensures orphaned channels are included in a specific sidebar category.

methods.name: completePopulatingCategoriesT
methods.description: Ensures orphaned channels are included in multiple categories, such as channels and DMs.

methods.name: getOrphanedSidebarChannels
methods.description: Retrieves channels not explicitly assigned to any sidebar category for a user and team.

methods.name: GetSidebarCategory
methods.description: Fetches a sidebar category with its channels by category ID.

methods.name: getSidebarCategoryT
methods.description: Internal method to fetch a sidebar category with channels from a database.

methods.name: getSidebarCategoriesT
methods.description: Retrieves all sidebar categories and their channels for a user and team.

methods.name: GetSidebarCategoriesForTeamForUser
methods.description: Public method to get sidebar categories for a specific user and team.

methods.name: GetSidebarCategories
methods.description: Public method to get sidebar categories for a user and team.

methods.name: GetSidebarCategoryOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the order of sidebar categories for a user and team.

methods.name: getSidebarCategoryOrderT
methods.description: Internal method to get sidebar category order from database.

methods.name: UpdateSidebarCategoryOrder
methods.description: Updates the order of sidebar categories for a user and team.

methods.name: UpdateSidebarCategoryOrderT
methods.description: Internal method to update sidebar category order in database.

methods.name: UpdateSidebarCategories
methods.description: Updates multiple sidebar categories and their channels, maintaining consistency and order.

methods.name: UpdateSidebarChannelsByPreferences
methods.description: Syncs sidebar channels with user preferences, especially favorites.

methods.name: removeSidebarEntriesForPreferenceT
methods.description: Removes sidebar entries for a specific user preference.

methods.name: addChannelToFavoritesCategoryT
methods.description: Adds a channel to the favorites sidebar category based on user preference.

methods.name: DeleteSidebarChannelsByPreferences
methods.description: Deletes sidebar channels based on user preferences, mainly for favorites.

methods.name: UpdateSidebarChannelCategoryOnMove
methods.description: Handles moving a channel to a different team by removing its sidebar category entries.

methods.name: ClearSidebarOnTeamLeave
methods.description: Removes all sidebar categories and channels for a user leaving a team.

methods.name: DeleteSidebarCategory
methods.description: Deletes a custom sidebar category and its channels.

methods.name: DeleteAllSidebarChannelForChannel
methods.description: Deletes all sidebar channel entries for a specific channel.
